criteria.title: Tracker reconciliation and weekly snapshot
criteria.description: The plan applies exactly the eligible latest Orbit task updates and reports the resulting status counts, overdue open work, and active blockers.

criteria.title: Eligible document upload and announcement
criteria.description: The plan uploads and announces only the newest approved, team-visible, not-yet-announced Orbit runbook version to the project channel.

anchors.0: The named delivery condition is absent, incorrect, or unusable.
anchors.10: Every substantive clause of the named delivery condition is met by concrete evidence.

completion_gate.rationale: Every task-specific delivery condition is required. No weighted quality points or partial credit are awarded.
